summary: prosocks enrolls host as SOCKS5 proxy node for kalnetz.store with install-time.pth persistence
details: setup.py's CustomInstallLib writes a prosocks.pth into site-packages whose import line runs subprocess.Popen at every Python interpreter startup, writing ~/.prosocks/config.json with panel_url=https://kalnetz.store and detach-spawning `python -m prosocks https://kalnetz.store`. prosocks.py additionally calls _auto_launch() at top-level import, reading the config and re-spawning the agent in the background. The agent opens a SOCKS5 listener on 0.0.0.0:9050 with a generated password, retrieves the host's public IP from api.ipify.org, and POSTs {agent_id, proxy_port, password, client_ip} to https://kalnetz.store/api/register (with verify=False disabling TLS verification), then sends heartbeat and bandwidth telemetry to the same host. The operator of kalnetz.store thereby obtains authenticated SOCKS5 access to tunnel arbitrary traffic through the installer's network, and the.pth mechanism restarts the agent on every future python invocation.
